record_title: Critical power-log Hellinger transition in compact-support location families
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: One-dimensional compact-support location family only; no likelihood-ratio limit experiment, estimator limit distribution, or sharp minimax estimation constant is proved. The adaptive consequence is only up to universal constants. Older nonregular-location and approximation-theory translation-modulus literature remains a residual originality risk.
